articles.summary: Visteon Corporation (NASDAQ: VC), a global leader in automotive cockpit electronics, will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, October 22. The Company will host a conference call for the investment community at 9 a.m. ET to discuss the results and related matters. The conference call is also available to the public via live audio webcast . The dial-in numbers to participate in the call are: U.S./Canada Participants Toll-Free Dial-In Number: 1-833-461-5787 International Participants Toll Dial-In Number: 1-585-542-9983 Conference ID: 257149910 (Dial-in approximately 10 minutes before the start of the conference.) The conference call and live audio webcast, related presentation materials, news release and other supplemental information will be accessible in the Investors section of Visteon's website. Shortly after the call, a replay of the webcast will be available on the Company's website. About Visteon Visteon (NASDAQ: VC) is
articles.title: Visteon To Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on October 22
